# lumos_entitlement (Data Source)

An entitlement on an app: a role, license, group or permission. App Store settings show here read-only; manage them with `lumos_entitlement_appstore_settings`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "entitlement_id" {
  type = string
}

# Reads one entitlement by its ID, for example to show its label and the app
# it belongs to.
data "lumos_entitlement" "this" {
  id = var.entitlement_id
}

output "entitlement_label" {
  value = data.lumos_entitlement.this.label
}

output "entitlement_app_id" {
  value = data.lumos_entitlement.this.app_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of this entitlement.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app that owns this entitlement.
- `approval_workflow_override` (Attributes) The entitlement's approval workflow override. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=approval_workflow_override for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_workflow_override))
- `appstore_settings` (Attributes) The entitlement's AppStore-catalog settings. Null unless expanded with expand=appstore_settings. Omitted entirely (not present, not null) when the parent app isn't enrolled in the AppStore. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings))
- `custom_approval_message_override` (String) This entitlement's own custom approval message, shown to requesters when the entitlement is approved, overriding the app's. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's approval message.
- `deprovisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's deprovisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=deprovisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deprovisioning_workflow))
- `description` (String) The description shown to requesters: `description_override` if set, otherwise the integration's own description. Read-only; set `description_override` instead.
- `description_override` (String) The description set in Lumos, kept across syncs. Null when none is set, and the entitlement shows its integration's description.
- `entitlement_type_label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement's type (e.g. 'Role', 'License', 'Group').
- `label` (String) Human-readable label for the entitlement (e.g. a role or permission name).
- `provisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The entitlement's provisioning workflow. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=provisioning_workflow for the full workflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning_workflow))
- `source` (String) How this entitlement was discovered. `manual` is created in Lumos; other values come from an upstream integration.

<a id="nestedatt--approval_workflow_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_workflow_override`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the bound workflow.


<a id="nestedatt--appstore_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appstore_settings`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_requester_group_uuids_override` (Set of String) UUIDs of the groups whose members may request this entitlement, overriding the app's allowed requester groups. Null means the entitlement inherits the app's groups.
- `request_validation_webhook_uuid` (String) UUID of the inline webhook called to validate access requests for this entitlement. Null means the entitlement has no webhook of its own.
- `time_based_access_override` (Attributes) This entitlement's own time-based access options. Null means this entitlement inherits the app's time-based access options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--appstore_settings--time_based_access_override))
- `visible_in_appstore` (Boolean) Whether this entitlement is visible in the AppStore catalog.

<a id="nestedatt--appstore_settings--time_based_access_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `appstore_settings.time_based_access_override`

Read-Only:

- `options` (List of String) Labels of the time-based access options for this entitlement's override, referencing options already defined for the organization. Must contain at least one label. To inherit the app's options instead, omit `time_based_access_override` or set it to `null`.
